content: Hello! I aim to create high quality sheets on a wide variety of topics. This thread is for news about and discussion to improve any of these sheets. I'm always open to feedback, questions or suggestions but I will only do things I feel like doing in my spare time. I'm steadily improving and my standards are getting higher. That means some older sheets might not quite be up to par with the newer ones.
**List of Sheets in reverse chronological order:**

**Trialpears' BJP Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ft3UxxBTiYBiBRmmLCuSpCznTFJQGRMLvf30r_qHo2w/edit?gid=0#gid=0
Instead of the traditional HP math which doesn't account for crits, talents, attack speed and personal time preference I use a reference boss with an optimal amount of pickles to determine how many you should use for the others. In my experience this gives much better results. I use Dr Defecause as my reference since you can respawn him with fewer pickles by leaving and reentering. Start high and work your way down to a good amount.

**Trialpears' Land Rank Optimizer Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_Z0-mJKRMxjFb0CSmg9MlfxDgdtwNyeVDd-7Bb1wXzs/edit?gid=0#gid=0
The goal of this sheet is to easily maximize the land rank allocation with the least effort possible. Only the values in the input section needs to be changed for full Land Rank recommendations to be generated. The Goal Ratios can be changed if you disagree with my recommendations and the sheet will do its best to adapt.

**Trialpears' Building Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1h5is0oaPAqd9YggBV9a7VDQxbGun6Aa_x-wl-8RWenk/edit?gid=0#gid=0
Calculate the amount of time and materials it will take to reach a certain building level

**Trialpears' Stamp Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qAsIRqYKhPTzFgtCy62KxgSDb_Nm1AfpwXyyIDNj9fo/edit?gid=95416029#gid=95416029
Visualize which stamps you can upgrade with this sheet by importing your stamp levels and calculating your carrying capacities. There is also a list of roughly the max reachable levels for each stamp.

**Trialpears' Forge Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Eze9PMKApb3gfZpbZ07VF3e89Zxa5yL6nKAZnWGoKSs/edit?gid=346873799#gid=346873799
How many ores, oils and archer claims are required to produce a given amount of bars? This sheet has the answer!

**Trialpears' XP sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yR3WkBYExpNf-focMDKQ3yIpUbLVW32DFr3SGQ1byW4/edit?gid=203174796#gid=203174796
Answers the question "when will I reach my next goal level in trapping or divinity?", several expansions are planned as of writing but are put on hold due to the imminent release of the hole update

**Trialpears' Sample Setup**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aW_lVDeIMZjIc5u5yy8Np1z7ixmNV-Hy49aCWYGv210/edit?gid=0#gid=0
What I decided to print and why during my June resample after consulting various players. My priorities have changed slightly and there will be a major update next time I resample.

**Trialpears' New Spice Gathering Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dRFrReLJZvwOJLmal7Kak72LlUODQhWSdKHhFIm5vxs/edit?gid=551930001#gid=551930001
Team recommendations for gathering the first spice after unlocking a new spice territory as quickly as possible. Build 5: Fastidous often ends up being optimal.

**Trialpears' Crappy Tome Sheet**
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10C_iicokjNTcmj4Jjzy1jAO7Pqxg4lkslVWx-VooeVs/edit?gid=1981643157#gid=1981643157
Tome calculator including max points. WIP as of December 30
